programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Michelle and Kaeng make baby dinosaur puppets, then explore the Creature Carousel in the Play School Dino Museum. They tell the story of Tui the Triceratops and her twins. 'Through The Windows' we go on a dino egg hunt!

programs.desc: Bush Doof: The Wiggles head to a bush doof for some wiggly fun outdoor dancing and wrap things up with a lively performance of Do the Propeller live on stage! (S8, ep 25).

programs.title: Thomas & Friends
programs.desc: Thomas befriends a stray dog who is wandering around the railway and tries to find him a home. In the process, Thomas derails and the fuzzy little dog raises the alarm.

programs.title: Tish Tash
programs.desc: Pola is pretending to be a horse for Bobby and Tish but just before it's Tish's turn, Pola gets up saying he wants a rest.

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: When a young Watermelonsuchus gets beached during a heatwave, Ginger and the Baby Pea Rexes have to get creative to work out a way to get the giant baby into the water.

programs.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programs.desc: Andy travels 15 thousand years into the past to meet a giant prehistoric sloth. On the way, he is stalked by a Sabre-toothed cat and rides a colossal Columbian mammoth.
